sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 180. Success value 100. 2x magic damage (Time).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Removes Awakening standby mode.
-Target: all allies. Healing Ability Power 90. Heals HP.
-Target: all allies. Removes status ailments.
-Target: all allies. Removes debuffs.
-Target: all allies. Increases time elemental defense by 80 for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies excluding yourself. Fills Unison gauge by 25.
-Target: yourself. Increases Unison gauge gains by 3 for 60 seconds.
Time Unison damage Ability Power boosted by 40 when equipped in the Main Slot.
